S26.01.note: Card and viewer are in MessageBubble.tsx and InlineArtifactCard.tsx; the card has no fixed visible words beyond the artifact title.
steps: Sign in and open a chat.
Ask the assistant for a small self-contained web page or a code file.
Wait until the reply finishes and a card appears under it.
Tap the card.
Compare: a full-screen viewer opens with the same artifact (Expected: the card opens the artifact).
S26.01.where: Chat > open a reply that writes an artifact > tap the card under that reply (it shows the artifact title and type in capitals)

S26.02.needs: an artifact with a name and one without (for example a diagram or web page without a title)
S26.02.note: The viewer title is built in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx from the artifact title, with the type appended after a middle dot.
steps: Open a chat with an artifact and tap its card.
Read the bold title at the top left of the viewer.
Read the title on the card in the chat.
Check the fallback: an artifact with no name shows the kind name, for example 'Web page' or 'Diagram'.
Compare with Expected: title shown on card and viewer, with a fallback.
S26.02.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > read the title at the top of the viewer (it reads 'title · TYPE')

S26.03.note: Card shows the language if set, else a type label; viewer shows language or type in capitals. The word 'Spreadsheet' was not found in apps/mobile; the kind labels come from a shared package outside apps/mobile.
steps: Open a chat with an artifact of a known kind (for example a chart or a document).
Look at the small capital-letter word on the card, such as CHART or DOCUMENT.
Tap the card and read the type after the middle dot in the viewer header.
Compare with Expected: kind shown on card and in viewer.
S26.03.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > read the capital-letter type word in the viewer header; the card shows the same word under its title

S26.04.needs: a model reply long enough to watch while it writes
S26.04.note: A finished artifact shows no state word; it shows the normal card. What makes a write 'Failed' (the failed prop) was not traced and the stop control was not located.
steps: Send a request that asks for a long artifact.
While the reply is still writing, look at the card for 'Writing…' under its title.
Stop the reply before it finishes, if the app offers a stop control.
Look at the card for 'Stopped' (title becomes 'Stopped artifact').
Compare with Expected: being written, finished, stopped or failed each shown.
S26.04.where: Chat > send a request that makes an artifact > while the reply is still writing, the card shows 'Writing…'; a stopped or failed write shows 'Stopped' or 'Failed' on the card

S26.05.note: Library opens the artifact gallery route (apps/mobile/src/features/artifacts/index.tsx) for the tapped item.
steps: Open the side menu and tap 'Library'.
Tap the 'Artifacts' filter chip.
Tap an artifact to open it.
Compare: its content shows in a view (Expected: open from chat or a list).
S26.05.where: Menu (side drawer) > Library > 'Artifacts' filter chip > tap an artifact; or in chat, tap an artifact card

S26.06.note: The X is an icon; its visible word is only the accessibility label 'Close' with hint 'Returns to the conversation'.
steps: Open an artifact from its card in chat.
Tap the X icon at the top right of the viewer.
Check the viewer closes and you are back in the conversation.
Check the card is still under the reply.
Compare with Expected: closing hides it and it stays available.
S26.06.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > tap the X (accessibility name 'Close') at the top right of the viewer

S26.07.needs: an account with a saved artifact; a way to restart the app
S26.07.note: No separate reopen toggle was found; reopening is done through the card or the list. The reload survival relies on the artifact store (apps/mobile/src/features/artifacts/store.ts) and was not run.
steps: Open an artifact, then close it with the X.
Tap the same card again or open it from Library > Artifacts.
Force-quit and reopen the app, then open the chat and tap the card.
Compare: the same artifact opens (Expected: reopen after close and after reload).
S26.07.where: Chat > tap the same artifact card again; or Menu > Library > 'Artifacts' > tap the artifact

S26.10.note: No separate expand button was found; the viewer is always a full-screen modal on open.
steps: Tap an artifact card in chat.
Check the viewer fills the whole screen.
Tap the X to return to the conversation.
Compare with Expected: the artifact can be expanded to full screen and returned from.
S26.10.where: Chat > tap an artifact card; the viewer opens over the whole screen and closes with the X

S26.12.needs: a conversation with two or more artifacts
S26.12.note: The switcher appears only when the conversation has more than one artifact; its row shows artifact titles, with no fixed visible words.
steps: Open a conversation with at least two artifacts.
Tap one artifact card to open the viewer.
Look for the row of artifact titles under the header.
Tap another title in the row.
Compare: the viewer shows that artifact without closing (Expected: switch without leaving the viewer).
S26.12.where: Chat > a reply or conversation with two or more artifacts > tap one artifact card > use the row of artifact titles under the viewer header to switch

S26.14.needs: a previewable artifact (for example an HTML page)
S26.14.note: Which kinds count as previewable (isPreviewable) was not traced.
steps: Open an HTML or diagram artifact from its card.
Tap 'Source' and read the code.
Tap 'Preview' and read the rendered view.
Compare with Expected: switch between the rendered preview and the source.
S26.14.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > tap 'Preview' or 'Source' in the tab row under the viewer header (shown only for artifacts that can be previewed)

S26.16.needs: an artifact with two or more versions (made by editing it first)
S26.16.note: The code has no visible 'Read-only' label. Editing is only offered for the newest version of a non-generated file (canEditSource). Shared-copy read-only was not found.
steps: Open an artifact that has at least two versions.
Step back to an older version with the left arrow next to 'Version N of M'.
Tap the More artifact actions button (three dots).
Check that 'Edit source' is not listed for the older version.
Compare with Expected: the older version is viewable without changing it.
S26.16.where: Chat > tap an artifact with two or more versions > tap 'Previous version' to an older version > tap the More artifact actions button and look for 'Edit source'

S26.20.needs: an artifact with two or more versions
S26.20.note: The 'Version N of M' text is an accessibility label (ArtifactFullScreen.tsx), not a visible word.
steps: Open an artifact with more than one version.
Read the 'Version N of M' control under the header.
Tap it to open the 'Version history' sheet.
Tap a version row to show that version.
Compare: the viewer shows the chosen version and its number (Expected: see and pick any version).
S26.20.where: Chat > tap an artifact with two or more versions > tap the 'Version N of M' button under the viewer header to open 'Version history'

S26.21.needs: an artifact with two or more versions
S26.21.note: The arrows are icon-only; their words are accessibility labels.
steps: Open an artifact with at least three versions.
Tap the left arrow ('Previous version') and check the version number changes.
Tap the right arrow ('Next version').
Check the arrows are dimmed at the first and last version.
Compare with Expected: step to previous and next and see which version is shown.
S26.21.where: Chat > tap an artifact with two or more versions > use the left and right arrows beside 'Version N of M' under the viewer header

S26.23.needs: an artifact with two or more versions
S26.23.note: No confirmation dialog was found on the restore path; restoring happens directly.
steps: Open an artifact with at least two versions.
Step back to an older version with the left arrow.
Tap 'Restore' (accessibility label 'Restore version N').
Check the viewer now shows the restored content as the newest version.
Open 'Version history' and check the versions in between are still listed.
S26.23.where: Chat > tap an artifact with two or more versions > step to an older version > tap 'Restore' in the version row under the viewer header

S26.29.needs: none; a way to view the saved file
S26.29.note: Artifacts with one format save directly; generated files use the share sheet instead.
steps: Open an artifact from its card.
Tap the download icon in the top bar.
If the 'Download as' sheet opens, tap a format such as Markdown, PDF, Plain text or Word.
Save or share the file in the system sheet that opens.
Compare: the file is in the chosen format (Expected: each choice saves that format).
S26.29.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > tap 'Download artifact' (download icon) in the top bar; if several formats exist, choose one in the 'Download as' sheet

S26.30.note: The copy icon is icon-only; 'Copied' is the accessibility label after success. Failure label is 'Could not copy'.
steps: Open an artifact from its card.
Tap the copy icon in the top bar.
Check the icon changes to a check mark and the label reads 'Copied'.
Paste into Notes or the chat box.
Compare: the pasted text matches the artifact's content (Expected: a copy control puts that content on the clipboard and confirms).
S26.30.where: Chat > tap an artifact card > tap the copy icon ('Copy content') in the top bar, then paste elsewhere

labels.text: Private. Only you can open it until you publish it.

S26.32.needs: an AGI Cloud account; a published or workspace-shared artifact; a private one for the private line
S26.32.note: A private artifact shows no card chip; the private line appears only in cloud mode under the publish condition in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud and open an artifact that has been published or shared.
Look at the small chip on its card in chat (and in Library > Artifacts).
Open the artifact and check the publish area of the viewer.
For a private artifact, check the line 'Private. Only you can open it until you publish it.'
Compare with Expected: private, published, or workspace state is visible.
S26.32.where: Chat > an artifact card shows a small chip under its title: 'Published', 'Workspace' or 'Invited'; viewer shows 'Private. Only you can open it until you publish it.' in AGI Cloud mode

labels.text: This preview stopped with an error.

S26.35.needs: an artifact that fails to render (made by asking the assistant for a broken page)
S26.35.note: A load timeout shows 'This preview did not finish loading.' instead; an invalid SVG shows "This image couldn't be rendered."
steps: Open an artifact whose page fails to run (for example an HTML page that throws an error on load).
Read the error panel: 'This preview stopped with an error.'
Tap 'View source' and check the source opens.
Go back to Preview and tap 'Retry'.
Compare with Expected: an error panel that explains the failure and offers source or retry.
S26.35.where: Chat > open an HTML or React artifact that fails to render > the viewer shows 'This preview stopped with an error.' with 'Retry' and 'View source'

S26.39.needs: a reply that writes an artifact slowly enough to watch
S26.39.note: Live update was traced in StreamingArtifactCard.tsx; the speed of growth was not run.
steps: Send a request that asks for a long artifact such as a code file.
While the card shows 'Writing…', tap the card.
Watch the viewer as the content grows.
Compare with Expected: the artifact view updates live while the reply writes.
S26.39.where: Chat > send a request for an artifact > while the reply is writing, tap the card titled 'Generating artifact' (it shows 'Writing…')

S26.40.needs: phone width (the iPhone build or a phone-sized simulator)
S26.40.note: This is a layout rule: the viewer is a full-screen Modal (overFullScreen, slide animation) in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx, so its effect is only seen on screen.
steps: On a phone-sized screen, tap an artifact card in chat.
Check the viewer covers the full screen with no side panel.
Check the buttons in the top bar are large touch targets.
Tap the X to return.
Compare with Expected: full-screen reader with touch controls.
S26.40.where: Phone screen: tap any artifact card in chat; the viewer opens as a full-screen slide-up view with the X at the top right
